asr.full_text: This is Shah and let's break down what's happening with Doge right now and what the market structure is telling us. The current price of Doge is around 0.104. In the last update we clearly marked the mini support at 0.11 and explained that price was still bearish at that time. We also said that if a one-hour candle closed below that level, Doge could drop toward the next major support at 0.10. That is exactly how price reacted. Once Doge lost the 0.11 mini support, selling pressure increased and price quickly moved lower. The market was already weak and low liquidity conditions made it easier for price to slide down. After losing that support, Doge dropped toward the 0.10 area, which is a very important psychological and technical level. Buyers stepped in there, and we saw a bounce from that zone. Now it is important to understand what this bounce actually means. This move does not automatically mean that DOGE has turned bullish on higher timeframes. What it does tell us is that 0.10 is acting as a strong demand area for now. Price respected the support and that reaction is what is keeping Doge alive in the short term. On the lower timeframe price structure is slowly improving after the bounce. However, the market is still fragile. There is a high chance that Doge could retest the support again. Retests are normal and healthy especially after a sharp drop followed by a bounce. As long as price holds above 0.10 during these retests, the short term direction can remain to the upside. The key thing to watch now is how DOGE behaves around this support zone. If buyers continue to defend 0.10 and price starts making higher lows on the lower timeframe, then we can expect a move back towards previous resistance areas. The first important level above is the old mini support at 0.11, which has now turned into resistance. A clean reclaim and hold above that level would be the first sign of real strength returning. If price fails to hold 0.10, then the structure will weaken again, and DOGE could move into a deeper correction. That is why this level is critical. It is not just a random number, but a level that has repeatedly attracted buyers in the past market conditions are still sensitive and overall sentiment depends a lot on what bitcoin does next if the broader market stabilizes doge has a chance to build a base here if volatility increases again we could see another quick move in either direction.
